ceu: ✦ The conjunction between Mars and Jupiter

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. There is more intensity than usual, so take it easy.
With Venus retrograde in your relationships sector, people and feelings from the past may become important again.
s.d: Say no to a task that is not yours.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on home and family. The energy is all in one place: use it with intention.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Accept an invitation that is different from usual.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.

Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
With Venus retrograde in your romance sector, review what you value before making choices in love or money.
s.d: Speak frankly about a matter you keep avoiding.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on your money and what you value. What you do here today has more strength than usual.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Give way on something small to gain on something big.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on your image and your personal energy. A decision made today will stand on firm ground.
With Venus retrograde in your communication sector, it is better to adjust what already exists than to start something new.
s.d: Book that test or check-up you keep putting off.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on rest and your inner life. Focus, and leave the rest for tomorrow.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Allow yourself a sweet or a treat without guilt.

t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on friends and plans for the future. The sky points the way: all you have to do is follow it.
With Venus retrograde in your self-image sector, people and feelings from the past may become important again.
s.d: Tidy a drawer or a corner of the house that bothers you.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on your career and your goals. A new beginning may be born from here.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Take a different route on your usual way.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. This is where your strength lies today.
With Venus retrograde in your friendship sector, review what you value before making choices in love or money.
s.d: Treat yourself to a small comfort that costs almost nothing.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.

Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Wear a colour you really love and notice how it changes your mood.

t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.

Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on relationships and partnerships. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
With Venus retrograde in your horizons sector, it is better to adjust what already exists than to start something new.
s.d: Switch off your phone an hour before bed.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on routine, daily work and health. Do not scatter yourself: one goal at a time.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Introduce two people who could help each other.
